facts.fact: 清晨她提议回去，Orzo 反而搂得更紧。
facts.anchor: “We should head back,” I whisper to Orzo, but he only curls up closer to me.

facts.fact: 她说从前的男人多半半夜爬下她的床。
facts.anchor: Usually my encounters with men led to them crawling out of my bed in the middle of the night

facts.fact: 一通电话后他要两趟车。
facts.anchor: “I understand. I need a ride.” He looks down at me. “Two rides.”

facts.fact: 挂断后他说这不能是他们唯一的一次。
她重提不承诺，他说自己不是在要一段关系。

facts.anchor: The words are a bucket of ice, an uncomfortability I don’t expect.

facts.fact: 她发现自己有陌生的占有欲。
facts.anchor: There’s a possessive nature that is entirely unfamiliar.

facts.fact: 他用她从没给过的密码解锁她的手机。
facts.anchor: He unlocks it with a code I never gave him

facts.fact: 他存下号码并承诺随叫随到、不问原因。
facts.anchor: “My number is in here. If you need me, I will be there. No questions asked.

facts.fact: 她忘了 Orzo 对她的了解已超出常理。
facts.anchor: And my brain forgets how much Orzo seems to already know about me.

facts.fact: 他问是否该为另一个男人给她发短信而不快。
facts.anchor: “Should I be upset another man is already texting you?”

facts.fact: 那条路通向真实而可怕的世界。
facts.anchor: That will lead us back to the real and scary world.
